products.name: White Marble Floral Mosaic tiles 12x12"
products.shortDescription: Soft white marble fan mosaic designed for refined powder rooms, shower niches and statement backsplashes.
products.descriptionHtml:
Carrara Fan combines classic marble veining with a graceful scallop silhouette for residential and boutique hospitality projects.

Application: Powder room walls, shower niches, kitchen backsplashes and decorative feature zones.

products.name: Emerald Glass Hexagon Tile
products.shortDescription: Jewel-toned glass hexagon mosaic that adds reflective depth to kitchens, wet areas and pool-adjacent spaces.
products.descriptionHtml:
Emerald Glass Hexagon offers saturated color, crisp geometry and a luminous finish for feature walls and backsplashes.

Application: Kitchen backsplash, wet bar, shower wall, pool house accent and outdoor covered areas.

products.name: Pearl Waterjet Bloom Mosaic
products.shortDescription: Iridescent shell mosaic with waterjet floral detailing for elevated custom interiors.
products.descriptionHtml:
This waterjet-cut shell mosaic delivers a refined bloom pattern with subtle iridescence. It performs beautifully in boutique bathrooms, vanity walls and bespoke furniture inlays.

Application: Decorative panel, vanity wall, boutique hotel suite and custom furniture.

blocks.title: About Us
blocks.content: Lansic Tiles curates mosaic surfaces with material depth and project discipline.

contentTranslations.fr: Lansic Tiles conçoit des surfaces mosaïques avec exigence matière et rigueur projet.
contentTranslations.pt: A Lansic Tiles desenvolve superfícies em mosaico com profundidade material e disciplina de projeto.
contentTranslations.de: Lansic Tiles kuratiert Mosaikoberflächen mit Materialtiefe und Projektdisziplin.
contentTranslations.ja: Lansic Tiles は素材の質感とプロジェクト精度を大切にしたモザイクを提案します。
contentTranslations.zh: Lansic Tiles 专注于兼具材质深度与项目落地能力的马赛克表面系统。

blocks.title: Brand story
blocks.content:
We combine material sourcing, pattern refinement and cross-border delivery to support designers, builders and homeowners seeking premium mosaic surfaces.

Our catalog spans marble, glass, shell and custom waterjet compositions, with flexible support for bespoke hospitality and residential projects.

contentTranslations.fr:
Nous combinons sourcing matière, affinage des motifs et livraison internationale pour accompagner designers, promoteurs et particuliers.

Notre catalogue couvre marbre, verre, nacre et compositions waterjet personnalisées.
contentTranslations.pt:
Combinamos sourcing de materiais, refinamento de padrões e entrega internacional para apoiar designers, construtores e clientes finais.

Nosso catálogo inclui mármore, vidro, madrepérola e composições waterjet personalizadas.
contentTranslations.de:
Wir verbinden Materialbeschaffung, Musterentwicklung und internationale Lieferung für Designer, Bauunternehmen und private Auftraggeber.

Unser Sortiment umfasst Marmor, Glas, Perlmutt und individuelle Waterjet-Kompositionen.
contentTranslations.ja:
素材調達、パターン調整、越境配送を組み合わせ、デザイナーや施工会社、住宅案件を支援します。

大理石、ガラス、シェル、水刀切割の特注構成まで幅広く対応します。
contentTranslations.zh:
我们结合材料 sourcing、图案优化与跨境交付，服务设计师、工程方与高端住宅客户。

产品覆盖大理石、玻璃、贝母以及定制水刀拼花等多种方向。
